reconcile.note: Gill distinguishes Jeremiah's condemned reading of ordinary astrological omens from the extraordinary eschatological signs Christ himself predicts in Luke's Gospel.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, s.v. "Should we look for signs from heaven?" (1999).

sides.snippet: don't be dismayed at the signs of the sky
sides.verseText: Thus says Yahweh, \"Don't learn the way of the nations, and don't be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

sides.snippet: There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
sides.verseText: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
